up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity records for the human single-protein target CHEMBL3572 (Cholesteryl ester transfer protein) with IC50 standard type. Return these exact columns: assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Apply filters: standard_relation = '=', pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Order results by molecule_chembl_id ASC, then assay_chembl_id ASC. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assays ass ON td.tid = ass.tid JOIN activities act ON ass.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3572' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000
